settings.label: Found in loot and at traders
settings.description: The pack's guns, magazines and ammo turn up in loot and in the Gunsmith's stock, like the game's own.

settings.label: Start new games with the pack's guns
settings.description: New games begin with every pack gun, loaded, and a box of each of their ammo (what doesn't fit is at your feet). Off: find or buy them in the game.
